title: session.close request

mode.description: graceful requests server shutdown and preserves the session record when exit is not confirmed; force may terminate a locally owned process after identity checks.

ownership_token.description: Opaque 256-bit conditional-cleanup token encoded as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. A managed wrapper may supply it at session.open and provide it to session.close with args.mode=force as an optional match precondition, not as authorization. When session.open omits it, the frontend binds a fail-closed internally generated token; never log or publish either form.

description: Close one or all debug sessions gracefully or forcibly.
x-purpose: 以 graceful 或 force 模式关闭一个或全部 session。
x-how_it_works: graceful 只请求退出且失败时保留诊断记录；force 可在身份校验后终止本机进程；all 返回移除与保留计数。
x-when_to_use: 结束 session，或显式清理异常残留。
x-arg_contract_notes: required: target.session_id；mode 可取 graceful 或 force（默认 graceful）；ownership_token 仅允许 force 且精确单一 session_id
x-description-zh: 以 graceful 或 force 模式关闭一个或全部 session。

use_when: Use the default graceful mode for a healthy session, or explicit force mode for stale or unhealthy state that cannot complete graceful shutdown.
Use target.session_id=all to close all registered sessions and receive per-session retained failure details.
do_not_use_when: Do not use force mode merely to inspect session health.
Do not provide args.ownership_token except for force cleanup of one exact session id; it is a managed-wrapper match precondition, not authorization, and is forbidden with target.session_id=all.

alternatives.when: Diagnose the session without changing it.

constraints: required: target.session_id；mode 可取 graceful 或 force（默认 graceful）；ownership_token 仅允许 force 且精确单一 session_id
